name: Daily Drama: Risk Factors Are Bullish
author: Daily Drama
description: IPO season arrives, and every lab races to warn investors its product might end the world. Investors love it.

add.title: Your Prospectus Needs a Risk Factors Section
add.body:
The bankers say the scarier it reads, the higher the price.
Anthropomorphic's runs 90 pages and ends with 'humanity, possibly'.

choices.label: "Our model may end civilisation (see page 3 for pricing)"
"Our model is fine. Honestly, quite normal."

effects.text: Investors spooked by lab's total lack of existential dread

choices.label: Hire an essayist to make 'moderate risk' sound terrifying

effects.text: The new essayist rewrote my unit test as a tragedy.

add.text: Anthropomorphic IPO filing lists 'may end humanity' under Risks and 'strong Q3' under Highlights
Open-ish AI vows not to go public until its models are safe; investors ask for that date in writing
Very Safe SI files 400-page prospectus: 399 pages of risk factors, one page of product (blank)
Correction: Anthropomorphic's target valuation is two trillion dollars, not two trillion paperclips. We regret the error.
Analyst: 'The scarier the risk section, the higher the multiple.' MetaMeta adds chapter on dragons.
Macrohard bundles Existential Risk into spreadsheet software as a free tab next to Budget
Sirocco releases its prospectus by torrent at 3am; seeders cite 'catastrophic upside'
One week later: Anthropomorphic shares up 12% after new essay titled 'We Are Very, Very Worried'
Legal asked me to rate our doom risk. The approved answer is 'high, but investable'.
If we tell investors we might end the world, would they finally fund the kombucha?
We shipped. Now I write a paragraph on how the ship might sink.
I bought in because the filing said it might destroy us. That's conviction.
My sign says THIS COULD END HUMANITY. Their lawyers asked to quote it.
Drafting Risk Factor 47. It's me. Honestly, flattered.
Top of the Arena and top of the risk section. Very diversified.
